name: Time series to network
summary: Computes a connectivity matrix (correlation, covariance, partial correlation, tangent or precision) from regional time series with nilearn and saves it as a network (JGFZ) for the brainlife network pipeline.
description: Reads a TSV of time series (one column per node) and its JSON node metadata, computes the chosen nilearn ConnectivityMeasure, zeroes the diagonal and writes a weighted network in compressed JSON Graph Format with the column names and metadata as node properties. Use it to turn parcel-wise fMRI time series into a functional connectivity network for later network analyses.

inputs.description: Input time series used to construct the connectivity matrices.
inputs.requirements: TSV with one column per node (column headers become node labels) and a JSON list with one metadata entry per node.

outputs.description: Network generated from the connectivity matrix

parameters.description:
Measure of similarity used to create the connectivity matrix.

[1] G. Varoquaux et al. “Detection of brain functional-connectivity difference in post-stroke patients using group-level covariance modeling, MICCAI 2010.
